record.title: EuroHPC extends the medium-scale AI Gigafactory tender deadline to February 2027
record.summary: On 2026-10-26, the Czech Ministry of Industry and Trade reported that EuroHPC had again extended the medium-scale AI Gigafactories tender deadline (Lot 1) to 4 February 2027, with Lot 2 unchanged. EuroHPC's current call page confirms the lot-specific deadlines and says the extension gives Member States time to complete national budget procedures and submit financial commitments. This is a procurement-calendar change; no consortium award, committed funding, facility construction, operating capacity, or resulting compute access is established.
organizations: Czech Ministry of Industry and Trade

claims.label: DEMONSTRATED
claims.text: On 2026-10-26, the Czech Ministry of Industry and Trade reported that EuroHPC had extended the bid deadline for Lot 1, the medium-scale AI Gigafactories call, to 4 February 2027, while the Lot 2 deadline remained unchanged.

claims.label: DEMONSTRATED
claims.text: EuroHPC's current call page lists Lot 1 bids due 4 February 2027 at 17:00 Europe/Luxembourg and Lot 2 bids due 3 December 2026 at 17:00 Europe/Luxembourg; it says the Lot 1 extension allows Member States to complete national budget procedures and submit financial commitments.

evidence_gaps.description: The dated tender corrigendum was not available in the Funding & Tenders Portal view inspected; the EuroHPC call page itself currently provides the changed deadline and states the reason.
No consortium selection, signed funding commitment, facility construction, or operating compute availability is established by these schedule sources.

brief.importance_rationale: If the tender ultimately produces facilities, the Lot 1 schedule affects the timing of a substantial European compute-infrastructure procurement. This score reflects the possible consequence of that infrastructure; it does not imply award, investment, capacity, or implementation outcomes.
limitations: The two official sources support the reported tender schedule and its stated rationale; they do not establish an awarded consortium, financing actually committed, facilities built, or compute available to users.
The EuroHPC page does not display the date on which the deadline amendment was adopted; 2026-10-26 is the date of the Czech ministry's public report.
organizations: Czech Ministry of Industry and Trade

technical.claimed_result: EuroHPC's current call page lists the medium-scale Lot 1 deadline as 4 February 2027 at 17:00 Europe/Luxembourg and the large-scale Lot 2 deadline as 3 December 2026 at 17:00 Europe/Luxembourg.
technical.demonstrated_result: The official EuroHPC call page displays those lot-specific deadlines and the stated reason for the Lot 1 extension; the Czech ministry's dated release reports the second extension.
technical.mechanism: EuroHPC states that Lot 1's tender deadline was extended to allow Member States to complete national budget procedures and submit financial commitments.
technical.regime: EU procurement call EUROHPC-2026-CEI-AIGF-01 for selecting consortia to establish medium-scale (Lot 1) and large-scale (Lot 2) AI Gigafactories.
technical.strongest_baseline: The Czech ministry says the earlier Lot 1 deadline was 3 December 2026; the current official call page now lists 4 February 2027 for Lot 1 while retaining 3 December for Lot 2.

brief.title: EuroHPC extends the medium-scale AI Gigafactory tender deadline to February 2027
brief.why_it_matters: The extension changes the timetable for bids to establish medium-scale AI Gigafactories, a potential route to substantial European AI compute capacity. The evidence establishes a tender schedule and its stated budget-procedure rationale, not selected consortia, public or private financing, completed facilities, or available compute.
